summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features: Copy Link button for custom pages, 4 additional mock custom pages (total 7), and Quick Link dropdown in Menu Manager. ALL 10 FEATURES TESTED AND WORKING CORRECTLY. App runs in MOCK MODE.
passed_tests: Dashboard Pages tab shows 7 custom pages (About Us, Shipping Policy, Size Guide, Loyalty Program, FAQ, Store Locations, Careers)
Careers page shows 'Bản nháp' (Draft) status since is_published=false
6 pages show 'Đã xuất bản' (Published) status
Copy Link button (copy-page-link-*) exists on each of the 7 page cards
Copy Link button triggers toast message 'Đã sao chép liên kết' (Link copied)
Draft page (Careers) does NOT have View button (only published pages have it)
Published pages have View button (view-page-*)
Custom page /shop/the-elite-shop/page/loyalty-program renders correctly with Elite Rewards content
Custom page /shop/the-elite-shop/page/faq renders correctly with FAQ content
Custom page /shop/the-elite-shop/page/store-locations renders correctly with 3 store locations
Draft page /shop/the-elite-shop/page/careers returns 'Page not found' (404 behavior)
Dashboard Menu Manager has Quick Link dropdown (menu-link-picker-*) for each menu item
Quick Link dropdown shows built-in links: Home (🏠), Categories (📂), Contact (📞)
Quick Link dropdown shows 3 blog posts with 📝 prefix
Quick Link dropdown shows 7 custom pages with 📄 prefix
Selecting a page from Quick Link auto-fills the URL field (/shop/the-elite-shop/page/about-us)
Selecting a page from Quick Link auto-fills the label if empty (About Us)
Menu Manager allows typing custom URLs manually (tested with https://example.com/custom-url)
Menu items max 10 limit enforced - Add button hidden at 10 items
Max limit message 'Đã đạt tối đa 10 mục menu' shown when at 10 items
critical_code_review_comments: All 3 new features implemented correctly and working as expected
Copy Link button uses navigator.clipboard.writeText() - works in browser but may fail in headless test environments due to permissions
Quick Link dropdown properly lists built-in pages, blog posts, and custom pages with appropriate emoji prefixes
Draft pages correctly excluded from public view (returns 404)
Menu Manager properly enforces 10 item limit
seed_data_creation: None - using existing mock data from mockData.js with 7 custom pages
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features tested and working: (1) Copy Link button on page cards in dashboard Pages tab, (2) 7 custom pages total with Careers as draft, (3) Quick Link dropdown in Menu Manager with auto-fill. Login page may appear blank in Playwright - use localStorage.setItem('auth_token', 'mock-token-user-demo') and navigate to /dashboard. The app runs in MOCK MODE with all APIs intercepted by mockAdapter.js.

mocked_api.note: Mock mode is intentional for standalone frontend development/demo

copy_link_button.behavior: Copies page URL to clipboard, shows toast 'Đã sao chép liên kết'

quick_link_dropdown.location: Dashboard > Menu tab > each menu item row
quick_link_dropdown.auto_fill_url: WORKING - fills URL field with page path
